verdict.rationale: CockroachDB's official Cloud MCP server lets agents explore live schemas and run queries using OAuth or API key auth. Its tools cover read and write operations such as listing tables, executing statements and inserting rows. The evidence does not show the tools are scoped or labeled to separate read-only from destructive actions, which is the core of the safe-delegation story. Missing for 10: explicit read-only vs destructive tool scoping or permission modes, documented schema/DDL tool coverage, guardrails or confirmation for destructive operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
